Titles.eng: Love Hina
Titles.jpn: ラブひな

Summaries.eng: Keitaro Urashima is determined to be accepted into Tokyo University, the hardest Japanese University of all to get into, because of a promise he made to a girl when he was young... a girl whose name he can't even remember. After failing to get into Tokyo U twice, he is kicked out by his parents and goes to live with his Grandmother at her hotel, but it seems it has been turned into an all girls boarding house. What's more, much to his surprise and to the tenants disgust, Keitaro is made manager of the boarding house.
Summaries.jpn: 浦島景太郎は幼い頃に女の子と交わした約束を果たそうと、東京大学の入学を目指す19歳。しかし、彼はすでに2浪の身。家を追い出され、祖母が経営する東京近郊の温泉旅館を頼るのだが、そこは彼の知る昔の姿とはまるで違っていた。唐突に「女子寮」の管理人となってしまった景太郎は、ドタバタに翻弄されながらも、東大入学、そして「約束」に近づこうと奮戦していく。

Titles.eng: Christmas Special - Silent Eve
Titles.jpn: クリスマススペシャル 〜サイレント・イヴ〜

Summaries.eng: Keitaro decides whether or not to confess his love to Naru. Eventually he confesses, but Naru's reaction is not as he had hoped.

Titles.eng: Love Hina Spring Special - I Wish Your Dream
Titles.jpn: ラブひな 春スペシャル ～キミサクラチルナカレ!!～

Summaries.eng: Keitaro and Naru are taking the second exams. Keitaro takes a look at the exam and has confidence that he can pass it. Then he starts daydreaming about how he and Naru will get married afterwards, then he wakes up and the examiner announces there are 5 minutes left. Keitaro runs away and applies for a job overseas, then ends up on a mysterious island after jumping into the ocean.

Titles.eng: Love Hina Again - OVA 1: Kanako
Titles.jpn: ラブひなAgain - 可奈子

Summaries.eng: After an injury prevents him from enrolling in Tokyo University, Keitaro decides to travel the world instead. A mysterious girl takes his place as manager of the Hinata Inn.

Titles.eng: Love Hina Again - OVA 2: Keitaro
Titles.jpn: ラブひなAgain - 景太郎

Summaries.eng: When Keitaro returns from his trip, he wants to be alone with Naru to give her a special gift. Unfortunately, Kanako has other plans.

Titles.eng: Love Hina Again - OVA 3: Naru
Titles.jpn: ラブひなAgain - なる

Summaries.eng: Once Keitaro remembers his promise to Kanako, he becomes conflicted over what to do. Meanwhile, Naru must come to terms with her true feelings about Keitaro.

Titles.eng: Love Hina Final Selection
Titles.jpn: ラブひなFINAL SELECTION ～アニメ総集編&LOVE HINA LIVE in 東京BAY N.K.～

Summaries.eng: A summary episode of the TV series.

Titles.eng: Love Live Hina

Summaries.eng: This is a concert video of the Love Live Hina that took place at Zepp Osaka on August 6, 2000

Titles.eng: Motoko's Choice: Love of the Sword: Don't Cry!
Titles.jpn: 素子のセンタク、恋か剣… 泣くな

Summaries.eng: Out of nowhere, Motoko's sister appears and is ready to pass on the dojo. However, Motoko is still not quite as strong as her sister and when big sister finds out about this, she gives Motoko an ultimatum: Motoko must beat her sister or marry Keitaro!

Titles.eng: All-Girls Dorm with Outdoor Bath: Hot Springs
Titles.jpn: 露天風呂つきの女子寮 温泉な

Summaries.eng: The unlucky Keitaro is given a break when his grandmother asks him to be the manager of Hinata Inn. Keitaro accepts but little does he know that since he's last been there, the inn's become a girls' dormitory! None of the tenants are all too happy about a male living with them until they begin to believe that he's a student of Tokyo University.

Titles.eng: The Hinata's New Resident Shinobu: Arrow Signs
Titles.jpn: ひなた荘の新住人しのぶ 矢印な

Summaries.eng: Shinobu's parents are getting divorced and she doesn't seem to have many friends at school but Keitaro and the girls welcome her with open arms which leads her to decide to stay at the inn instead of living with either of her parents.

Titles.eng: Kendo Girl In Love?: Swordplay
Titles.jpn: 恋する!? ケンドー娘 剣劇な

Summaries.eng: The master of the sword, Motoko, returns from a training retreat only to find that Keitaro has been named the manager of the inn.  She's outraged and is completely against a male being the manager but becomes confused by weird feelings that consume her body.  Could it be love?

Titles.eng: The Tokyo U Promise From 15 Years Ago: Diary
Titles.jpn: 東大の約束は15年前 日記な

Summaries.eng: The girls discover that Keitaro is not really a Tokyo University student and to make things worse, his studies don't seem to be going very well. Seeing this, Keitaro decides it's time to leave Hinata Inn.

Titles.eng: Wow, a Trip to Kyoto! Exciting
Titles.jpn: 急接近! 京都二人旅 ドキドキハラハラな

Summaries.eng: It's time for the exams for Tokyo University, and unfortunately, both Keitaro and Naru fail. Disappointed, they go their own separate ways to take a break from Hinata Inn. Or do they?

Titles.eng: Keitaro's First Kiss is with...? Journey
Titles.jpn: 景太郎、初キス? の相手 旅路な

Summaries.eng: After finding out that both Keitaro and Naru are in Kyoto, the rest of the girls at Hinata Inn assume they're going to commit double suicide and go after them. Meanwhile, Keitaro and Naru help a girl named Mutusmi get back home which is located on the other end of Japan!

Titles.eng: First Date, Keitaro's True Feelings: Nowadays
Titles.jpn: 初デート、景太郎のしたごころ いまどきな

Summaries.eng: Keitaro scores two tickets to Neverland and plans on asking Naru to go with him for the grand opening. However, a new face appears and his name is Sakata Kentaro. He's richer, better looking, and smoother than Keitaro. He also has tickets to Neverland. Things don't look so hot for Keitaro.

Titles.eng: Kendo Girl and the Legend of the Dragon Palace: Is This a Dream?
Titles.jpn: ケンドー娘の竜宮伝説 夢かな

Summaries.eng: During meditation, Motoko enters a dreamworld where everyone is living in an RPG. Keitaro is a knight on a quest to save Naru from the Dragon King and the silliness of it all turns off Motoko. But as she continues to meditate further, she finds a lesson in the dream.

Titles.eng: The Case of the Missing Hinata Apartment Money: A Mystery
Titles.jpn: ひなた荘密室現金強奪事件 ミステリな

Summaries.eng: A thief has stolen the rent money of Hinata Inn and everyone panics. That is everyone except Detective Kitsune and her sidekick Kaolla Su. The cast begins to assemble the clues and attempt to solve the mystery of the missing rent money.

Titles.eng: Who Is the Beautiful Woman Wandering in the Moonlight? Transformation
Titles.jpn: 月夜にさまよう美女の正体は? 変身な

Summaries.eng: A mysterious woman appears in Hinata with her pet alligator. The duo are wreaking havoc all across town and Kentaro claims that it's actually a grown-up version of Kaolla. Is it?

Titles.eng: The Idol Shooting for Tokyo U is a Prep School Student: Sing
Titles.jpn: 目指せ東大生アイドルは予備校生 歌うな

Summaries.eng: Naru becomes a celebrity all across Japan as an idol and this, of course, leads to Keitaro worrying about her studies. He begins to believe that Naru no longer cares about getting into Tokyo University and becomes incredibly depressed.

Titles.eng: Changing After the Wedding? Swordmaster Motoko's Sunday Best: Feminine
Titles.jpn: お色直し? 剣豪モトコの晴れ着姿 女の子な

Summaries.eng: When Motoko runs out of clothes as they're all in the laundry, she is forced to wear a dress. Furthermore, her swordsmanship has been foiled by not only Tama-chan but also Keitaro. This leads her to doubt herself and things get worse when Mecha Tama-chan begins to create havoc.

Titles.eng: The First Kiss Tastes Like Lemon? Marshmallow? Adult
Titles.jpn: 初キスの味はレモン? マシュマロ? おとな

Summaries.eng: After witnessing Keitaro almost kiss Naru, Shinobu wonders what a kiss is like. Supposedly, it tastes like a lemon and is as soft as a marshmallow and thus begins Shinobu's quest for her first kiss.

Titles.eng: Naru's Crush Is Now a Tokyo U Professor: Turning Into Love?
Titles.jpn: 再会? なる憧れの人は今東大講師 ラブへな

Summaries.eng: Hinata Inn is having a financial crisis and everyone must take up a part-time job. When Keitaro becomes an assistant for Naru's first love, Kitsune becomes incredibly worried and curious at the same time about what might happen when Naru discovers that Seta is back in town.

Titles.eng: I Love You! Romantic Confession Inside a Cave: Tall Tale
Titles.jpn: 好き! 洞くつの中のラブラブ宣言 ほらあな

Summaries.eng: When Keitaro has to take care of Seta's adopted daughter, Sara, Naru of course finds out about Seta. Keitaro begins to give up his hope of Naru ever liking him and decides to help her be happy instead.

Titles.eng: Monkey Performance at the Seaside Teahouse Hinata: A Kiss?
Titles.jpn: 海の家・浜茶家ひなたのサル芝居 チュウかな

Summaries.eng: The tenants of Hinata Inn are working part-time at a beach tea house and decide to perform a play to increase revenue. Keitaro is still incredibly glum about the whole Seta and Naru situation and it's pretty understandable.

Titles.eng: Mesmerized by Naru on the Haunted Island! Something's Fishy!
Titles.jpn: 海…なるにドキッ! 妖怪にクラッ 妖しいな

Summaries.eng: Naru becomes possessed by an evil spirit and Motoko is the only one who can destroy it. Unfortunately, she doesn't know the technique to kill the spirit without killing the body and it's quite a predicament.

Titles.eng: Girls Dressed in Yukata for the Summer Festival: Let's!
Titles.jpn: それぞれの浴衣のきみと夏祭り ほな

Summaries.eng: Seta has to leave on an excavation trip and asks if Sara can stay with the girls at the inn.  Sara doesn't take too kindly to this and decides to run away while causing as much trouble as she can to everybody else.

Titles.eng: Marry into Money? A Prince from Across the Sea: Warm
Titles.jpn: 玉の輿? 海のむこうの皇太子 暖かな

Summaries.eng: A man who happens to look exactly like Keitaro when he wears glasses appears and is later found out to be from Kaolla's home country. He is here to get married to Kaolla but she decides she isn't quite ready yet, but tradition says she must.

Titles.eng: A Sepia-colored Promise with a Sleeping Girl: A Trick?
Titles.jpn: 眠りの少女とセピア色の約束 カラクリな

Summaries.eng: Keitaro discovers a doll that can move on its own. Everyone is amazed by it but Keitaro seems to be able to hear it talk also. He finds out from the doll that his great grandfather promised to fix its legs but never did and being the good guy he is, Keitaro decides to fulfill his ancestor's promise.. With the help of the girls, of course!

Titles.eng: Jealous Outburst? Two Lovebirds on a Boat: Tremble
Titles.jpn: 嫉妬爆発!? ボート上のお熱い二人 わなわな

Summaries.eng: Naru and Keitaro decide to go out to celebrate the latest grades and while both are wondering whether it's a date or not, a mysterious little girl appears.

Titles.eng: Little Sister Mei's Devious Plan: It Can't Be!
Titles.jpn: 妹メイのたくらみ、密室大作戦 そんな

Summaries.eng: Mei is Naru's stepsister and hopes to take Naru back home.  To accomplish this, she decides she has to hook Keitaro up with Mutsume and it is in this episode that Naru finds out something shocking.

Titles.eng: Naru Narusegawa - Her Wavering Heart and Keitaro: Crushed
Titles.jpn: 成瀬川なる、揺れる女心と景太郎 こなごな

Summaries.eng: Naru now wonders what she should do with her newfound knowledge and it seems like Keitaro is going to be returning home since his grandma has returned to reclaim the inn. To add more to the mess, it doesn't look like Keitaro's studies are going to be enough to help him into Tokyo University.

Titles.eng: Celebrate! Are the Blooming Flowers Tokyo U? Love? Everybody
Titles.jpn: 祝! サクラサクのは東大? 恋? みんな

Summaries.eng: The final episode of Love Hina. Everyone has to leave Love Hina for a day because the inn is going under renovations. It also becomes apparent that Keitaro won't be coming back to Hinata Inn and Naru has completely given up on Keitaro. Who will Keitaro decide to be his soulmate, Naru or Mutsumi?
